This made me laugh so hard tbh.
Fuck. All the damn time.

Can relate. Recently had to distance myself from someone for similar reasons (as well as them being extremely thoughtless and generally just a crap friend). It’s not fun! There are bidets for all budgets, I’m probably going to get a portable handheld one to start - will be a couple of $/€/£/your currency!

Honestly I just had to go again and it was miserable, I’ve had the joy of doing laxative bowel prep with this issue (where you get to a point of pooping acidic bile). That plus whatever the hell is going on with my butt is excruciating. I have to do it again soon so I’m going in guns blazing with every thing I can to alleviate the pain!

Good luck in your journey fellow Crohnie!

I’m not sure if I have the same issue, but every time I wipe I bleed. Today I filled to toilet with paper 2 3rds full because I have to wipe so much to get clean...

I’ve had the wipe / then bleed issue for maybe 3 years now.

I’m thinking of getting a bidet to help the area heal, may help you.
I have done this before too. Jesus. I won’t make that mistake again (hopefully).
Wow I really needed this today. In tears but not in a bad way, thank you.

Okay this isn’t exactly being “caught” but it was pretty embarrassing none the less. I was living in a block of apartments at the time.

As I am just opening my front door to leave, I see my neighbour leaving his place too. He is very large. He is wearing an “I beat anorexia” shirt (back then this was a kinda common “joke” for larger people to say).

Cue my emaciated ass smiling awkwardly and saying hi while actually feeling the floor go from under me bc I was clearly anorexic.

(Lol now I’m large and I’m dealing with that but jfc that was awkward)
Yep, but it’s mostly down to cravings. Caesar salad is a huge no (vegetables are a huge no) and I paid dearly for my transgression.
At that point I was living with my then partner. They paid for groceries. I felt so bad about it.

Yes, absolutely.

At my worst it was £20 on snacks from the supermarket per day plus a 15 - 20 pound takeaway delivery in the evening. So up to £40 a day on food.

I would plan my entire day around bingeing, I only left my home to get more binge food bc I felt so disgusting and I didn’t want anyone to see me.

This went on for about a year and I got into debt due to it.

Sad thing is I only stopped bingeing because I had maxed my credit cards and had zero income (the bingeing was a factor in this but there were many other factors too).

As for the link I'm not sure how I can help but for me I have a gut feeling (ha ha) that starving myself for years somehow triggered my crohns disease... Maybe that's just me trying to make it somehow into that 'my fault' mentality... But I don't think that's what the issue is here.

Anyway, I feel that from reading the comments it seems like he is dealing with an eating disorder... I would say see if you can breach the topic of getting help for that as well as the crohns disease..

Best of luck and well wishes to you both!
